text:
Erica: Quick post-all-hands thread for infra Qs only (GPU supply, regions, autoscale). Keep replies short.
Sam: Topline: hosted pool healthy for Q2; APAC spot variability remains our main short-term risk. We've reserved a small SG committed pool and an EU buffer for critical routes.
Maya: For upcoming product launch, can we request guaranteed pre-warm capacity?
Vikram: Yes  use the reservation API/CLI. We'll add a simple form for CS to request pre-warm with TTL and contact info.
Lina: Autoscaler: were we settled on burst absorption + adaptive cooldown? Any numbers?
Sam: Plan: token-bucket burst absorber (~30s) + adaptive cooldown (base 90s) + stepwise scale increments (x2). In sims this cut scale churn ~40%.
Maya: If APAC runs out and we spill to EU, how is customer billing handled?
Vikram: Hosted: short soft-fail spills are absorbed; persistent cross-region serving generates a bill annotation and an alert. Dedicated: opt-in auto-failover or manual approval.
Erica: Procurement note: A100 reorder ETA ~8 weeks; H100 pilot targeted Q3 pending kernel validation.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions recorded: sam/commit-pools-note, vikram/prewarm-CLI, lina/runbook-update, maya/prewarm-request
Sam: I'll post the procurement brief + committed pool terms in #eng-ops today. Thanks!
